question: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  r.year,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  r.name,
  r.day,
  r.time
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
ORDER BY
  d.dob DESC,
  r.year ASC,
  r.month ASC,
  r.day ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T3.year, T3.name, T3.month, T3.day, T3.time
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE T1.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND T2.raceId = (SELECT MIN(raceId) FROM qualifying WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1))
